# Generated Low Pass Depot completion routes

These fixtures contain legal native flight controls for the exact Living Routes
pilot `snake-hunt-ground-routes-low-pass-depot`, seed 9601. Both Self-level and Acro
finish in 1540 ticks, catch all three patrols, retain 100 health and report zero
solid contacts or shots. The accepted course, default Gentle response, native
collision backend and final states are pinned in `manifest.json`.

The inputs were generated by a position-feedback controller. It followed current
target positions with a two-second motion lead, used the ordinary flight axes and
throttle, and flew above the low structures before descending for contact. The
controller neither moved actors directly nor changed geometry, flight rules,
response, objectives, score, vulnerability or physics. The checked-in regression
replays the fixed inputs; it does not regenerate or repair routes during testing.

Each CSV row is `repeat,roll,pitch,yaw,throttle,actions`: repeat the quantized command
for that many consecutive native ticks. The manifest binds the CSV bytes, expanded
input identity and native proof header. The regression consumes every command
through `createWorldFlight`, checks recorder output, then verifies native replay
and the exact pilot qualification adapter.

These are software-generated simulation witnesses, not human play or artistic
approval. Other seeds, control usability, device/accessibility checks and public
release qualification remain pending. Run receipts belong to the source revision
that executed the tests; the fixture itself does not assert a clean build.
